NAME_MISMATCH.where: Bank Branch or Post Office / Aadhaar Centre
NAME_MISMATCH.form: KYC Update Form / Aadhaar Correction Form
NAME_MISMATCH.en: Go to the bank counter and say: 'My name on Aadhaar is {aadhaar_name}, but my bank passbook shows {bank_name}. I want to update my KYC as per my Aadhaar card. Please give me the form.' Bring your original Aadhaar card and passbook.
NAME_MISMATCH.bn: Bank-er counter-e jaao ebong bolo: 'Amar Aadhaar-e naam {aadhaar_name}, kintu bank passbook-e {bank_name} lekha ache. Aadhaar onujayi amar KYC update korte chai. Form-ta deben please.' Original Aadhaar card ebong passbook niye jaao.
NAME_MISMATCH.hi: Bank counter par jaiye aur boliye: 'Mera Aadhaar mein naam {aadhaar_name} hai, lekin bank passbook mein {bank_name} likha hai. Main apna KYC Aadhaar ke anusaar update karna chahta/chahti hoon. Form dijiye please.' Apna original Aadhaar aur passbook saath le jaiye.

DORMANT_ACCOUNT.form: Account Reactivation Request / Dormant Account Activation Form
DORMANT_ACCOUNT.en: Go to your bank branch and say: 'My account has become dormant due to no transactions. I want to reactivate it. What do I need to do?' Make any small deposit or withdrawal (even ₹1) to reactivate. Bring your passbook and Aadhaar.
DORMANT_ACCOUNT.bn: Aapnar bank branch-e jaao ebong bolo: 'Amar account-ta transaction na howar karone dormant hoye geche. Eta reactivate korte chai. Ki korte hobe?' Jebhabe bole seta koro — ekta choto deposit ba withdrawal (₹1 o cholbe) korle account active hobe. Passbook ebong Aadhaar niye jaao.
DORMANT_ACCOUNT.hi: Apni bank branch mein jaiye aur boliye: 'Mera account transactions na hone ki wajah se dormant ho gaya hai. Ise reactivate karna chahta/chahti hoon. Kya karna hoga?' Koi bhi chhoti deposit ya withdrawal (₹1 bhi chalega) se account active ho jayega. Passbook aur Aadhaar saath le jaiye.

AADHAAR_UNLINKED.form: Aadhaar Seeding Form / DBT Linkage Form
AADHAAR_UNLINKED.en: Go to your bank branch with your Aadhaar card and say: 'I want to link my Aadhaar number to my bank account for DBT — Direct Benefit Transfer. Please give me the Aadhaar seeding form.' This is required to receive government benefits directly.
AADHAAR_UNLINKED.bn: Aadhaar card niye bank branch-e jaao ebong bolo: 'DBT — Direct Benefit Transfer-er jonyo amar Aadhaar number-ta bank account-er sathe link korte chai. Aadhaar seeding form-ta deben please.' Sarkar-er benefit directly pete hole eta mandatory.
AADHAAR_UNLINKED.hi: Aadhaar card lekar bank branch mein jaiye aur boliye: 'DBT — Direct Benefit Transfer ke liye apna Aadhaar number bank account se link karna chahta/chahti hoon. Aadhaar seeding form dijiye please.' Sarkari labh seedha pane ke liye yeh zaroori hai.

ADDRESS_MISMATCH.where: Gram Panchayat Office / Ward Office / Municipal Office
ADDRESS_MISMATCH.en: Go to your local Gram Panchayat or Ward Office and bring both your Ration Card and Voter ID. Say: 'The address on my Ration Card does not match my Voter ID. I need the address corrected. Please help me with the form.' They will guide you on which document to update.
ADDRESS_MISMATCH.bn: Aapnar local Gram Panchayat ba Ward Office-e jaao. Ration Card ebong Voter ID duto niye jaao. Bolo: 'Amar Ration Card-er thikana Voter ID-r thikana-r sathe mile na. Thikana thik korte chai. Form-er jonyo help korben please.' Ke kon document update korben seta tara bolbe.
ADDRESS_MISMATCH.hi: Apne local Gram Panchayat ya Ward Office mein jaiye. Ration Card aur Voter ID dono saath le jaiye. Boliye: 'Mere Ration Card ka pata Voter ID ke pate se match nahi karta. Pata theek karna chahta/chahti hoon. Form ke liye help karein please.' Kaun sa document update karna hai, woh batayenge.

DOB_MISMATCH.where: Aadhaar Seva Kendra / Aadhaar Enrolment Centre
DOB_MISMATCH.en: Go to your nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra and say: 'The date of birth on my Aadhaar card does not match my Birth Certificate. I want to correct it.' Bring your Birth Certificate as proof. There may be a small correction fee.
DOB_MISMATCH.bn: Nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra-te jaao ebong bolo: 'Amar Aadhaar card-e jonmo tarikh Birth Certificate-er sathe mile na. Eta thik korte chai.' Proof hisebe Birth Certificate niye jaao. Ektu fee lagbe pare.
DOB_MISMATCH.hi: Apne nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra mein jaiye aur boliye: 'Mere Aadhaar card mein date of birth Birth Certificate se match nahi karti. Ise theek karna chahta/chahti hoon.' Proof ke liye Birth Certificate saath le jaiye. Chhoti si correction fee lag sakti hai.

MISSING_BANK_ACCOUNT.where: Any nationalised bank (SBI, UCO, Bandhan Bank preferred in WB)
MISSING_BANK_ACCOUNT.form: Account Opening Form (Jan Dhan / Zero Balance)
MISSING_BANK_ACCOUNT.en: Go to a bank branch and say: 'I want to open a zero balance savings account for government DBT benefits. I have my Aadhaar card and Voter ID.' Under Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, no minimum balance is required.
MISSING_BANK_ACCOUNT.bn: Ekta bank branch-e jaao ebong bolo: 'Sarkar-er DBT benefit-er jonyo zero balance savings account khulte chai. Amar kache Aadhaar card ebong Voter ID ache.' Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana-r under-e minimum balance lagbe na.
MISSING_BANK_ACCOUNT.hi: Kisi bank branch mein jaiye aur boliye: 'Sarkari DBT labh ke liye zero balance savings account kholna chahta/chahti hoon. Mere paas Aadhaar card aur Voter ID hai.' Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana ke tahat minimum balance nahi chahiye.
